title: Sweet Potato Chilli
description: Hearty vegetarian sweet potato chilli with kidney beans, lentils, peppers and warming spices, ready to serve with rice or wraps.

ingredients.text: 450g sweet potato, peeled and cut into 1cm (½in) chunks
300ml vegetable stock (1 vegetable stock cube dissolved in 300ml boiling water) (200ml
2 tsp Henderson’s relish or Worcestershire sauce
2 tsp chilli powder, or to taste
1 × 400g tin kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1 × 400g tin green lentils, drained and rinsed
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
fresh coriander and red onion, to serve

steps: Spray a saucepan with low-calorie cooking spray and place over a medium heat.
Add the onions, pepper and garlic and fry for 5 minutes until the onions start to soften, then add the sweet potato, 300ml stock, vinegar, relish, paprika, chilli powder and ground coriander.
Stir and cook for a further 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, beans and lentils and stir well.
Once it’s bubbling, reduce the heat and cover.
Cook for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sweet potato is tender and the sauce is rich and thick. Loosen it with a splash of water if it seems too thick.
Season and serve with rice or wraps, coriander and red onion.
SLOW-COOKER METHOD   HIGH: 3–4 HOURS LOW: 6–8 HOURS
Spray a frying pan with low-calorie cooking spray and place over a medium heat.

Add the onions, pepper and garlic and fry for 5 minutes until the onions start to soften, then add the sweet potato, 200ml stock, balsamic vinegar, relish, paprika, chilli powder and ground coriander.
Stir and cook for a further 5 minutes.
Transfer everything to the slow cooker, add the tomatoes, beans and lentils and stir well.
Cover and cook for 3–4 hours on high or 6–8 hours on low.
When it’s ready the sweet potato will be tender and the sauce rich and thick. Loosen with a splash of water if it seems too thick.
Season and serve with your choice of accompaniment, coriander and red onion.
